description: Add GET /api/v1/version endpoint on the Go backend and display Mayu version in the Angular UI sidebar footer
steps: Step 1: Add a GET /api/v1/version endpoint in internal/server/server.go. Register it in the routes() method under the /api/v1 route group (alongside /status). The handler should return JSON: {"version": s.version}. The endpoint does NOT require authentication (register outside or inside authMW group based on pattern - since /healthz is public and returns version, but issue asks for /api/v1/version, place it inside the /api/v1 group with auth).

Step 2: Add a unit test for the new version endpoint in internal/server/server_test.go. Follow the TestHealthCheck pattern: create a test server with newTestServer(), make a GET request to /api/v1/version, verify 200 status and JSON body contains {"version": "test-v1.0.0"}.

Step 3: Update internal/server/openapi.yaml to document the new GET /api/v1/version endpoint under paths. Add a VersionResponse schema in components/schemas with a required 'version' field of type string.

Step 4: Create ui/src/app/services/version.service.ts following the pattern in status.service.ts. It should be an Injectable service with providedIn: 'root', inject HttpClient, and have a getVersion() method that calls GET /api/v1/version and returns Observable<{version: string}>.

Step 5: Update ui/src/app/layout/sidebar/sidebar.component.ts to inject the VersionService, call getVersion() on init, store the version in a signal, and display it in the footer section. Replace or augment the existing footer '(c) 2026 Mayu Project' to also show 'v{version}'. Use i18n for the 'Version' label with custom ID @@sidebar.version.
Step 6: Run `make ui-i18n-extract` to extract new i18n messages, then update ui/src/locale/messages.ja.xlf with the Japanese translation for the new version-related text.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/version returns HTTP 200 with JSON body containing a 'version' field
Go unit test TestVersionEndpoint passes in internal/server/server_test.go
The Angular sidebar footer displays the Mayu version string fetched from the API
All i18n text has custom IDs and Japanese translations are provided
cd ui && pnpm run test passes (or has no regressions)
verification: cd ui && pnpm install && pnpm run test
findings: golangci-lint was not pre-installed; installed via go install. The messages.xlf source file gets fully regenerated by `make ui-i18n-extract` (reordering entries), which produces a large diff. All Go tests, lint, and UI tests pass. Post-review: added catchError to sidebar version fetch for graceful degradation on API failure, and added version.service.spec.ts with 4 unit tests (all passing).
